lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs8Mg4Tl4Cl24 (reduced formula Cs2MgTlCl6) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 40 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg and Tl each adopt octahedral coordination by six Cl neighbors, while Cs exhibits a close-packed-like local arrangement of 12 Cl neighbors. Corner-sharing between Mg- and Tl-centered octahedra is observed, alongside face-sharing between Cs-centered 12-vertex polyhedra and both Mg- and Tl-centered octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 40 sites.
